title: wedelia iners
intro: Wedelia iners, commonly known as Wedelia or Little Goldenflower, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia iners include its potential to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
